correctness.rationale: Every agent-equivalence block is an exact two-state involution fiber, so equality of local successor-type sets forces equality under that involution. Induction over the generators identifies modal equivalence with equality of all rooted color functions. Finite modal partition refinement makes these classes precisely the generated Boolean atoms. Orbit-stabilizer and subgroup Möbius inversion yield the count, and primitive cyclic pair words minus reflection-fixed primitive words give the dihedral formula. Exhaustive finite algebra closure and subgroup checks corroborate the proof but are not generalized by extrapolation. Critical quantifiers include every finite nontrivial group generated by distinct involutions, every positive component count, and r>=0.

value.rationale: For every finite group generated by involutions and any number of disjoint copies, the result supplies a complete natural modal-generation classification and an explicit subgroup-lattice polynomial enumerating all generating r-tuples. This is useful for exact generator ranks and structured finite epistemic models; nonabelian S4 and uniform dihedral formulas illustrate reach beyond cycle-specific or toy counts. It is not claimed that primitive necklaces, subgroup Möbius inversion or generic modal refinement are original.
